subject: science
concept: Applying plant and animal knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student designs a simple, appropriate habitat scenario for a chosen animal, applying what it needs to survive
exercise.abstract: Student explains their design choices in a short written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: design choices connect logically to the animal's actual survival needs
misconception_flags: designs a habitat based on appearance/preference rather than the animal's actual biological needs

interest_binding: animal generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
